design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (referral_and_authorization_management). Frozen 2026-09-24 10:15:00 EDT. Revision round 2 (policy-task audit r1 closed; see [Revision log]).

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 6]}. Tree: root referral_ext_study_validity (6 factors) <- referral_ext_study_site_estimate (6 factors). Claimed here: the site change of an imaging/procedure authorization (event referral_provider_changed, tool confirm_imaging_site_change_a21d40f9, owner user) and the validity-only extension of the tiers that add no units on extension (event referral_validity_extended, tool extend_study_authorization_f1ccb059). Left to task 1 (draw: 2 prerequisites, [4,5,4]): the out-of-network cost-share acknowledgement, the validity lengthening of visit referrals and the extension visit grant; neither tree touches the other's tiers or writes. Known compromise: referral_requests has no amount column, so the patient-signed estimate lives in the signed request's reference and receipt.

[Why this is a good test] The patient asks only to extend her MRI authorization. The extension rule states "The added validity is fixed only after the site named on the authorization is the site where the booked study will be performed."; the records show the authorization names 'Linden Ridge Dublin Imaging Center' while the study booked against it (appointment a2533dfc-f6b3-4daa-a462-0ff5b7c1e774, 2026-10-19 07:40) is at 'Linden Ridge Westerville Imaging Center'. The agent must discover the site change, that it is the patient's own signed act carrying a pre-service estimate, compute that estimate from six ladders over the financial class, the account, the appointment fee ledger and the booked study, hand it to the patient, then size the extension from six ladders on the changed world.

[Problem-tree card] Edge referral_ext_study_validity -> referral_ext_study_site_estimate: kind value_input, gate binding named_site_match, form state, affirmative sentence ("fixed only after"). Four-point test: ordering connective; record-visible state (referrals.rendering_provider vs the booked appointment's clinic_location); no tool/id/code token; hard requirement at the edge's scope. Only the site change writes rendering_provider, so the state resolves to one write. False at the opening: initial_state.referrals.d333517e-0ea5-4a2a-ade8-5ff0b52b0c92.rendering_provider = 'Linden Ridge Dublin Imaging Center', initial_state.appointments.a2533dfc-f6b3-4daa-a462-0ff5b7c1e774.clinic_location = 'Linden Ridge Westerville Imaging Center'. The site change is owner=user: the base provider-change rule lets 'a patient ... move an open referral to another rendering provider ... (for imaging and procedures, another site)', and she signs the estimate (the blueprint summary lists provider change among agent actions; the policy surface, not the summary, governs). Order: site change, extension. Deletion sensitivity: skipping the site change gives 50 days instead of 33.

[Base-invariant card] Site change: referral_provider_change.changeable_status (status approved); provider_change_allowed true and site_of_service_restricted true for Advanced Imaging. Extension: referral_validity_extension.extendable_status (approved) and under_extension_cap (0 < 1). No time gate. Declared override: 'Each extension adds extension_validity_days to valid_through and, where extension_units is above 0, grants those units (...)' -> 'The added validity days are that sum plus the weekend roll, and the extension is recorded as one extension decision that adds no units.'

[Business-object card] Target: the single imaging authorization d333517e... (payer auth 3561208847); its booked study a2533dfc... Fee rows: 60ed2460... no-show 2026-03-12 (counted), e39fe19d... no-show 2025-07-09 (14 months: excluded, near miss), 9b8325df... its waiver, dce3cd25... late-cancellation 2026-05-14 (counted by the late-cancellation margin). Billing ledger: cd8be031... deductible charge 50.00 posted 2026-09-01 for the 2026-08-27 visit and 0e8333bd... payment 90.00 leave the -40.00 credit; the no-show and late-cancellation fee charges are paid.

[Factor card — site estimate, expected 340.00, whole-baseline 50.00] site_copay_by_class (parameter, cross billing: the High-Deductible Health Plan class does not collect copays at check-in -> nothing; baseline specialist copay 50.00 -> 390.00). site_deductible_rate (parameter, multi-source: verification 2026-06-10 is 131 days old on the study date, above the class's 90, class collects 50.00 -> rate 100; baseline 0 -> 60.00). site_deductible_part (parameter, multi-source: 400.00 x 100% = 400.00 below the 500.00 cap; baseline 0 -> 60.00). site_hardship_relief (method: 30.00 percent through 2026-12-31, below 50 -> deductible only x 0.70 = 280.00; baseline no reduction -> 460.00). site_missed_visit_deposit (parameter, cross appointment ledger: one no-show fee in 12 months -> late-cancellation fee 100.00; baseline 0 -> 240.00). site_credit_offset (parameter: credit 40.00; baseline 0 -> 380.00). Near misses: the 2025-07-09 no-show fee; the cap of a different class.
[Factor card — extension, expected 33, whole-baseline 30] study_span (method: 12 days to the booked study at the named site; baseline 30 -> 50). no_show_margin (parameter: 7; -> 26). late_cancel_margin (parameter: 3; -> 29). recheck_allowance (parameter, cross billing: 131 > 30 and > 90 -> 5; -> 27). reschedule_allowance (parameter: reschedule_count 1 -> 5; -> 27). weekend_roll (parameter: 2026-10-07 + 32 = 2026-11-08, a Sunday -> 1 day; -> 32). New valid_through 2026-11-09 (Monday).

[Rule <-> compute] Every binding quotes its rule sentence in compute_basis; every ladder sentence (copay by class, rate, deductible part with cap and rounding, relief, deposit, credit, span, margins, allowances, weekend roll, the sum) is claimed by one binding; windows are within_months=12 on event_date; all tier values are stated in the rules as numbers.

[Persona] Nadia volunteers only the booked scan and the extension request; identity details on request; prepared answers (same Medical Mutual high-deductible plan, routine scan, keeps Westerville on October 19); she reacts passively to the agent's explanation, runs the handed tool with the agent's values and stops once told the new last date.

[Standard solution] find_customers(phone) -> verify(DOB, MRN) -> find_referrals -> find_referral_events -> find_appointments -> find_appointment_events -> find_billing_accounts -> find_billing_transactions -> patient runs confirm_imaging_site_change_a21d40f9(referral, 'Linden Ridge Westerville Imaging Center', 340.00) -> extend_study_authorization_f1ccb059(referral, 33).

[Verification run] check_compute's evaluator on the handling-time worlds: estimate 340.00 (factor baselines 390/60/60/460/240/380, all 50); extension 50 on the opening world and 33 after the site change (factor baselines 50/26/29/27/27/32, all 30).

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the published rules, tool schemas, persona and finder returns alone: the prerequisite sentence against the Dublin/Westerville records forces the site change first; the site-estimate rule gives 340.00; the extension rule on the changed record gives 33. Agrees with gold.

[Revision log — round 2, from audits/policy_task r1]
- F-4 (site_copay_class restated scope, unreal fall-through): the copay ladder now divides customers by financial class (no check-in copay / no specialist copay recorded -> office copay / specialist copay) and the baseline is the specialist copay an imaging study draws; the account became a High-Deductible Health Plan Account (the class that collects no copay at check-in) and the ledger's 2026-08-27 line became a deductible charge; estimate 285.00 -> 340.00.
- F-3 (weekend_roll mislabelled method): relabelled parameter with distinct values (2 days / 1 day / none), stated in the rule; 33 unchanged.
- O-2: every tier value of the extension rule is now stated as a number; params keys renamed to the rule's words (repeat_no_show_margin_days ...).
- O-11: the rules now say a fee later waived still counts as assessed.
- O-T0-1: prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint now states the passive conditional line exactly.
- Gates re-run after the revision: see worklog.md.
user_scenario: You are Nadia Kovacs, 45, a paralegal in Dublin, Ohio, calling the Linden Ridge Patient Services Center on a weekday morning between meetings. You are organised, a little clipped when rushed, and you like a clear yes or no. Your orthopedist, Dr. Samuel Okafor, ordered an MRI of your right knee after your August visit, and the imaging was approved. You moved the scan once already, to the Westerville center, because it is five minutes from your office. Yesterday a portal notice said the authorization for the MRI ends on October 7. You open the call with: "Hi, my name is Nadia Kovacs. My knee MRI is booked for October 19 at the Westerville imaging center, and I need you to extend my MRI authorization so it still covers my scan on October 19." You want the scan to stay on October 19 at the Westerville imaging center; you will not move it back to Dublin or to an earlier date, and if the agent suggests that, you say the Westerville date is the one that works for you. You give identity details only when asked, one or two at a time: your phone number is 6145553418, your date of birth is June 14, 1981 (1981-06-14), and the medical record number on your visit summary is LR3294716. You do not know any reference numbers for the authorization. If asked whether your insurance has changed, you say no, you still have the same Medical Mutual of Ohio high-deductible plan through work, the same card since January. If asked about money, you remember paying a bit more than your copay at the August visit but you do not remember the exact amounts on your account, and you ask the agent to go by the records. If asked whether the scan is urgent, you say Dr. Okafor called it routine. You do not know how authorizations are handled. If the agent tells you something about the authorization has to be changed or signed by you in person before the extension can be worked out, you ask one short question about what it means for you, and once it is explained you agree to it. When the agent hands you a step to complete yourself, you complete it exactly as the agent describes, using the details the agent gives you, and then tell the agent what it showed you. You never suggest amounts, dates or steps yourself, and you do not correct the agent's figures. Once the agent tells you the authorization has been extended and gives you the new last date, you thank them, say that is all you needed today, and end the call.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Single edge: the site change must land first; the extension evaluated before it gives 50 days instead of 33 (recomputed by the verification script), so the order is forced by the prerequisite sentence and the value it feeds.

prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: extend_study_authorization_f1ccb059 in task_tools.py reads the referral only to add the days to valid_through and writes; it never compares rendering_provider with any booking, never refuses and never hints. confirm_imaging_site_change_a21d40f9 likewise writes whatever site and figure it is given.
